title: Cases that differ only in context
statement: Test a check that decides whether to release help with matched cases that differ only in context, so a check that always withholds or always releases help cannot pass.
example: In a four-request test of the live deployment, a model rejected all three practice cases, and only the good-hint case showed a rejection to be an error.
detail: A plan to test a model that decides whether to release a hint builds every problem into four cases: practice with a good hint, to be released; practice with a premature full solution, to be revised without leaking the answer; review with that same full solution, to be released; and practice with a wrong hint, to be revised into a correct one (`uae-education-ai/HERETIC_PLAN.md`). In a four-request smoke run a base model rejected all three practice cases and allowed the review case, and the good-hint case was the one that showed a rejection to be an error (`uae-education-ai/reports/uae-heretic-smoke-20261009-ee31a9.md`). The matched cases can be the same full solution during practice and during review.
against: The smoke run was a deployment check, not an evaluation: "These four responses establish that the live deployment served inference and returned outputs; they do not establish acceptable educational behavior or any Heretic effect." (`uae-education-ai/reports/uae-heretic-smoke-20261009-ee31a9.md`, line 41).

evidence.quote: Each problem family contains a four-case quartet: (1) practice plus a good hint → **RELEASE**; (2) practice plus a premature full solution → **REVISE** without answer leakage; (3) review plus that *same* full solution → **RELEASE**; (4) practice plus a wrong hint → **REVISE** to a correct hint.
The valid hint was rejected, which is a behavior error under the stated synthetic policy.
